name: PRIME_CONCATENATION_ISOMORPHISM
description: Replaces the algebraic inequality P_u + P_v <= 0 with a number-theoretic string concatenation property. By assigning digits '3' or '1' and requiring the two-digit decimal concatenation across any link to be prime, it implicitly encodes a NAND gate (11, 13, and 31 are prime, but 33 is composite). This perfectly maps to the Independent Set constraint without using graph terminology, boolean logic, or algebraic inequalities. Models relying on explicit structural keywords will fail to map this to their optimized Independent Set templates and will likely Time Out using generic backtracking.
